snippet.title: Loco: Rails & Tails annoucement trailer
snippet.description:
If you like what you see please wishlist Loco: Rails & Tails
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576920/Loco_Rails__Tails/

Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo in chaotic co-op adventure for 1-4 players. Come on, dig some coal and throw it in locomotive to speed it up. You have to deliver cargo before times runs out. Nobody likes when the train is delayed!
